title: Antalya — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Antalya: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Antalya has a population of 2,548,000. The Turquoise Coast’s crown jewel, a stunning Mediterranean resort city with ancient ruins and luxury beaches. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 10a growing zone supports Hot — tropical and subtropical crops, year-round growing. The population skews young, with a median age of 33.0.
